termsBody: This free reader account is for adults aged 18 or over. Joining does not require a purchase and does not prove that you bought the book. Available extras are listed in your library; future extras and release dates are not guaranteed. Use your own email address and keep sign-in links private. You can leave a book’s reader club in Preferences. To close your Mindbanger account, use the account settings or contact miroslav@mindbanger.com.
privacyBody: Miroslav Jobus / Mindbanger is the controller. We process your account ID, email address, language choices, book editions, memberships and consent records to operate the reader club you request. Marketing emails are optional and require a separate choice. We use Supabase for account and data services and Brevo for email delivery as processors. To request access, correction, deletion or other applicable data rights, contact miroslav@mindbanger.com. Read the full privacy notice for more information. When you register through a book link, we also remember the book and source channel carried by that link. This does not verify a purchase.
